name: test
description: Run one or more test commands for the workspace's toolchain and return each command's result separately. Commands run sequentially in the workspace root. A non-zero exit code (failing tests) is a normal result to read and iterate on, not an error.

detailed: Runs the workspace test suite and returns output.

whimsical: {source} is firing up the test track

detailed: tool {participantRole} is running the test suite

commands.description: The test commands to run, in order, for the project's toolchain (for example ["bun test"] or ["python -m pytest tests/"]).

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional per-command timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
